description: Intermodal Passenger Facilities - Amtrak Stations is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). The Intermodal Passenger Facilities - Amtrak Stations dataset was compiled on September 25, 2024 and was completed on October 27, 2024 from the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). Its keywords are transportation, USA, National, Canada, British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, NTAD. The bounding box given is -123.1029,25.8492,-69.9650,49.2742. The hub shows 2024-12-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
